+ 21 of the team's 21 passes attempted: the team ran through you. Your teammates felt that, even if the scoreboard didn't.

+ Missed tackles 0, from 3 in your previous match. That right there is what good teammates do.

THE BAD

- 62% passing (13 of 21, down from your usual 76%). Easy win: If nothing's on, keep it: shield, turn back, let the shape reset. Patience is a pass too. Clean it up and fly.
- Tackles attempted 0, down from your usual 3. One honest look at that and we move forward.
- Key passes 0, down from your usual 1. Golden rule: Switch play when they shift across. Quickest way to find space is usually on the far side.
- We shipped 5 goals to Mohamedudeman and lost by 5. That's on all of us, not just you, and all of us fix it.

THE UGLY
! Their best forward posted 10.0 to your 6.5. That isn't a dip. That's a no-show.

Session plan: Attack the box. Near post and far post on every cross and every cutback.

Before you go, PhogsToffees: Kindness costs nothing and wins locker rooms.

Better days are booked. - Coach Lasso
